programme.title: Beyond visits: China-EU new dynamics
programme.desc: In recent weeks, several European leaders have paid official visits to China amid a complex global landscape of competition and cooperation. What new signals are emerging in the next phase of China-EU relations?CGTN's Michael Wang speaks with Benjamin Norton, founder and editor-in-chief of the Geopolitical Economy Report, and Dong Yifan, associate research fellow at the Academy of International and Regional Studies at the Beijing Language and Culture University, to unpack the strategic considerations behind this wave of high-level exchanges and explore how intensified China–EU engagements could shape global supply chains and the future trajectory of global economic growth.

programme.title: Beyond the Games: How China's ice and snow economy is heating up
programme.desc: Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games, running from February 6 to 22, herald a new growth cycle for the global ice and snow industry. In China, winter sports are shifting beyond event-driven momentum toward market demand, wider consumer participation, and industrial upgrading. From ski resorts to equipment manufacturing and winter tourism, the sector is building long-term economic potential.In this special podcast episode, join CGTN's Zheng Junfeng and Lincoln Humphries as they speak with industry guests to explore how "cold resources" are becoming a lasting engine for the economy. #MilanoCortina2026 #wintervibe

programme.title: Around China: Step Into Xishuangbanna’s Everyday Life at the Ganlanba Market
programme.desc: Beneath the Ganlanba Bridge in Xishuangbanna, a local market has become part of everyday life for residents. From street-side snacks to regional specialties like ganbai chicken and sticky rice cakes, the market is filled with the sights, sounds and flavors of daily life. Guided by local residents, CGTN reporter Elle Liao takes you inside the market to capture the most authentic rhythm of life in Yunnan.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: mareTV: Santorini - The Beauty on the Powder Keg
programme.desc: The Santorini archipelago is a gem, but is located on a veritable powder keg. It is only a matter of time before the volcano, the crater rim of which gave us this island world, erupts again. Since January 2011, threatening rumblings have been perceived beneath the archipelago. On Santorini, it's a case of getting nowhere fast without a mule. Whether the restaurant terraces above the abyss of Oia, the hotels on the breath-taking cliffs of Imerovigli or Firostefani, it was only with the help of the stubborn climbing artists, that these daring constructions were made possible. Antonis Vlachos has ten strong mules that work for him. He transports almost everything with them: stones, food or...

programme.title: mareTV: The Blue and White Island World of Greece: Mykonos, Naxos and Tinos
programme.desc: Around the once sacred Isle of Delos, some 200 islands, including 20 larger ones, are arranged almost in a circle. This is where the name of the Greek island paradise comes from: Cyclades, a derivation of the Greek word kýklos, circle. Each cyclade has a unique character. The pelican Petros, about 20 years old, is the mascot of Mykonos. He moves from taverna to taverna all day long, scrounging fish. This works out sometimes well and sometimes not so well. Petros does have a few human friends who regularly slip him something, but all too often visitors eager to take pictures block his path. Then he has to "wiggle" his way through the crowd. Jackie Onassis is said to have once brought...

programme.title: The Turkish Riviera - The flair of antiquity and a turquoise sea
programme.desc: With a coastline boasting miles of bathing beaches, turquoise waters, breath-taking cliffs whilst being steeped in history, the Turkish riviera was even a fa-vourite of the Ancient Greeks, Romans and Ottomans, who all loved the mild climate and the lush landscape. Near the ruins of the ancient city of Side, Menderes Akdemir works on the latest attraction aimed at Riviera holidaymakers: his spooky pirate ship "Big Kral" is due to leave dry dock and head for the sea. Mehmet Özata came up with a very clever idea: to be able to cope with the basically ruinous puffer fish plague along the coastline, he produces a selection of leather utensils made of their skin. The islands that surround the...

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola....

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is...

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard...

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very...

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift...

programme.title: Namibia`s Desert Kingdom
programme.desc: Although the dunes are barren, the dry riverbeds show signs of growth. And out of the heat, vast shapes appear. A herd of desert elephants ambles along the dry riverbed sniffing the ground with their lazy trunks. These remarkable creatures can smell the water underground and know where to find it. An abandoned well attracts a troop of chacma baboons, followed by a small herd of oryx and springbok, and finally a group of jackals. None of them has seen the pride of desert lions lying in wait.

programme.title: Close up with Hippos
programme.desc: This nature documentary shows the many different sides of the Hippo’s lives on one September day in two iconic African locations: the Masai Mara-Nationalpark in Kenya, also the setting for the largest annual animal migration on the planet – one and a half million wildebeests and zebras migrate from the Serengeti to Kenya during this time.

programme.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side. In the Northern Serengeti, a group of male cheetahs emerges and turns all we know about them upside down. Males are usually loners or live in small groups, but here we have five tomcats hunting together as one. It is actually, the largest alliance of the animals ever seen! This film has many stories to tell about the sleek hunters.

programme.title: The Cape of Wild Animals, Episode 5
programme.desc: The movie focuses on committed animal rights activists, who fight for the lives of their charges every day, in diverse protection projects and rescue centres along the South African Garden Route.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Fish
programme.desc: They are virtually unchanged from their ancestors, who swam in ancient rivers when the dinosaurs still ruled the planet. Their unfertilised eggs became black gold, served in only the most expensive restaurants as caviar. This ancient giant is the Beluga Sturgeon, considered by some to be the largest freshwater fish in the world. Sturgeons are now at the very edge of extinction because of the exclusive market for their eggs, but only the eggs can allow the species to live. Paradoxically, the desire for caviar may now be the only chance they have for their future existence.

programme.title: Jacques Cousteau's Legacy - Return To The Undersea World
programme.desc: A composition of wildlife footage, archive material and elaborate re-enactments results in a brilliant reconstruction of the life of famed marine biologist and environmental pioneer Jacques Cousteau. On the trail of the most famous oceanographer of the 20th Century, the team spent two years filming original locations on three different continents, in four different oceans. The film charts how Cousteau’s outlook on the environment changed throughout his many decades at sea around the globe. On his personal journey to enlightenment, he changed from a man who killed sharks in hate and thoughtlessly blew up coral reefs, to a radical environmentalist.

programme.title: Lions On The Move
programme.desc: Kevin Richardson shares an extraordinary bond with Africa’s most fearsome predators. Together with them, he has experienced some real adventures. However, transporting 27 lions and 14 hyenas to a new home presents a different challenge.The lions' new home will be a sanctuary on the edge of Dinokeng, a South African game reserve spanning 18,000 square metres. The huge task ahead includes planning and designing the new enclosures, and securing permits to move the animals.

programme.title: Lions On The Move
programme.desc: Not only are the animals regularly rotated into new enclosures to prevent repetitive behaviour developing out of boredom, but Kevin also has to practice loading them in and out of the van. Can the reluctant lions and hyenas eventually be persuaded to get on board with the move?

programme.title: White Lions: Born Wild
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 White Lions: Born Wild - Episode 1: Against all Odds
programme.desc: The two sisters are born as white as snow in May 2009 in South Africa’s Kruger Park. Growing up in this vast, wild wilderness they must not only overcome the same survival challenges that all young lion cubs face, they must also overcome the threats their high visibility brings. In the African bush, anything unusual stands out and is often eliminated by eagle-eyed predators. Will our cubs survive? The odds are stacked against them – 80 percent of all newborn lion cubs don’t make it to adulthood.

programme.title: White Lions: Born Wild
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 White Lions: Born Wild - Episode 2: Fight for Survival
programme.desc: ‘White Lions – Born Wild’ is a true wildlife story, with strong characters and closely studied behaviour. We follow the cubs’ progress as they embark on the pathway to adulthood, learning to hunt, learning to avoid danger, learning to live in their white coats. This is a strong behaviour-led film, a coming-of-age story of a very rare and unusual pair of lions. Through their eyes, we learn what it is really like to be a lion in Africa.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Wild Moments: Funny Encounters 1
programme.desc: As an animal filmmaker, one often deals with lots of strange old birds. No wonder, that so much can go wrong. After a long day of filming, a surprise awaits at the camp: Wolves have been looking for chocolate biscuits! Yet these are not the only things that can happen in the Arctic. Yann Sochaczewski is out and about in the magnificent Grand Canyon. On his raft on the Colorado River, he risks life and limb in doing so. In Australia, Thoralf Grospitz and Jens Westphalen play cat and mouse with an odd bird, that turns out to be a real entertainer. In the Serengeti, Reinhard Radke despairs of the many tourists who constantly walk in front of his lens. Wildlife filmmakers travel around the...

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Wild Moments, Funny Encounters 2
programme.desc: When humans and wild animals live next door to one another, things can sometimes be a little hairy. Some organise themselves in impertinent gangs, others mutually cultivate their own friendships. In New Zealand, keas organise themselves into gangs and obviously have it in for all the rubber seals belonging to winter sports enthusiasts. Their motto: nibble all you can. In Australia, Klaus Weißmann and Rolf Sziringer struggle with a huge invasion. Thousands of flies have taken a liking to the two men. This causes frayed nerves. And in Zambia, Jens Westphalen and Thoralf Grospitz capture a veritable display of elephants with the camera. Every year, their fine noses lead them into a hotel...

A herd of desert elephants ambles along the dry riverbed sniffing the ground with their lazy trunks. These remarkable creatures can smell the water underground and know where to find it. An abandoned well attracts a troop of chacma baboons, followed by a small herd of oryx and springbok, and finally a group of jackals. None of them has seen the pride of desert lions lying in wait.

programme.title: Close up with Hippos
programme.desc: This nature documentary shows the many different sides of the Hippo’s lives on one September day in two iconic African locations: the Masai Mara-Nationalpark in Kenya, also the setting for the largest annual animal migration on the planet – one and a half million wildebeests and zebras migrate from the Serengeti to Kenya during this time.

programme.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side. In the Northern Serengeti, a group of male cheetahs emerges and turns all we know about them upside down. Males are usually loners or live in small groups, but here we have five tomcats hunting together as one. It is actually, the largest alliance of the animals ever seen! This film has many stories to tell about the sleek hunters.

programme.title: The Cape of Wild Animals, Episode 5
programme.desc: The movie focuses on committed animal rights activists, who fight for the lives of their charges every day, in diverse protection projects and rescue centres along the South African Garden Route.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Fish
programme.desc: They are virtually unchanged from their ancestors, who swam in ancient rivers when the dinosaurs still ruled the planet. Their unfertilised eggs became black gold, served in only the most expensive restaurants as caviar. This ancient giant is the Beluga Sturgeon, considered by some to be the largest freshwater fish in the world. Sturgeons are now at the very edge of extinction because of the exclusive market for their eggs, but only the eggs can allow the species to live. Paradoxically, the desire for caviar may now be the only chance they have for their future existence.

programme.title: Jacques Cousteau's Legacy - Return To The Undersea World
programme.desc: A composition of wildlife footage, archive material and elaborate re-enactments results in a brilliant reconstruction of the life of famed marine biologist and environmental pioneer Jacques Cousteau. On the trail of the most famous oceanographer of the 20th Century, the team spent two years filming original locations on three different continents, in four different oceans. The film charts how Cousteau’s outlook on the environment changed throughout his many decades at sea around the globe. On his personal journey to enlightenment, he changed from a man who killed sharks in hate and thoughtlessly blew up coral reefs, to a radical environmentalist.

programme.title: Lions On The Move
programme.desc: Kevin Richardson shares an extraordinary bond with Africa’s most fearsome predators. Together with them, he has experienced some real adventures. However, transporting 27 lions and 14 hyenas to a new home presents a different challenge.The lions' new home will be a sanctuary on the edge of Dinokeng, a South African game reserve spanning 18,000 square metres. The huge task ahead includes planning and designing the new enclosures, and securing permits to move the animals.

programme.title: Lions On The Move
programme.desc: Not only are the animals regularly rotated into new enclosures to prevent repetitive behaviour developing out of boredom, but Kevin also has to practice loading them in and out of the van. Can the reluctant lions and hyenas eventually be persuaded to get on board with the move?

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly...

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to...

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is...

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The U.S. East Coast, The Southern States
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has...

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore...

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and...

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests...

programme.desc: Water is life, and the great conductor that connects us all. The oceans cover over 70%of our planet and hold almost 97% of the earth's water. programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined theproperties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with DavidGross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, thedevelopment of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discoveryand exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

Thisdiscussion with Deepak Chopra breaks down many popular misconceptions aboutastrological predictions, the various disciplines of study, ego, and consciousness inrelation to astrology. Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting themost out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not theoutcome�that outcome is completely up to you. �I can give you questions to ask to helpyou decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.�

programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modernrenaissance of metaphysical idealism. This idea is often refutedby the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided byconsciousness.

programme.title: Nature, Space and Matter
programme.desc: Our understanding of the nature of time, space and matter have changed�even whatwe mean by these terms�in just the last few decades. Before quantum physics, people knew that humanbeings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with newrevelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Creation Is Constant

Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting themost out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not theoutcome�that outcome is completely up to you. �I can give you questions to ask to helpyou decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.�

programme.title: Modern Metaphysical Idealism
programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modernrenaissance of metaphysical idealism. His theoretical reflections on the mind explainconsciousness as the only element of life that allows us to understand reality, andeverything we know about reality is subject to our experiences. This idea is often refutedby the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided byconsciousness.

programme.title: Book Of Knowledge
programme.desc: Traveling the world 30+ years, David Verdesi finds himself back in Rome. Urged to uncover thereason behind the instinctive human desire for spiritual yearning, Verdesi starts retracing theintersection of science and theology within the city his family has called home since the early1400s.Vibrating from the walls of the city�s sacred spaces, he discovers findings of oral history,predating the beginning of humanity by thousands of years. Documents and rare rituals thatupend conventional ideas of the behaviors of the mind in ancient times. Narratives heavilyinfluenced by civilizations and cultures beyond Rome, continue to influence the moral compassof life today, Verdesi realizes he...

programme.title: Across the Ice
programme.desc: After 45+ expeditions throughout over 150+ countries, one of the world's leadingadventurers and visionaries of conservation, Swedish explorer Johan Ernst Nilsondawns upon his biggest adventure yet. Follow his journey across the planet from theNorth Pole to the South Pole in Pole2Pole. The 525 day mostly carbon-neutral trekcovers 20,000 miles by means of skis, dogsled, boat, bike and kite. Pole2Pole is notonly one of the most difficult adventures he�s ever attempted, but also one of his mostphilanthropic adventures. Johan visits charities along the way to share their stories andraise global awareness.

programme.desc: Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the American Southwest during the Desert Monsoon. He ups the danger factor by traveling with wild atheist shock-jock R.J. programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The “Angry Planet” team hopes to film the natural wonders and extreme phenomena of this fascinating Central Asian country, including a spectacularly burning crater of natural gas, underground lakes, sandstorms and remnants of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Angry Planet | Crystal Cave
programme.desc: In 2000, a remarkable find was made in Chihuahua, Mexico, of a spectacular cave filled with giant crystals, some over 20 meters long. But it is a intensely difficult spot to explore – with temperatures over 50 degrees C and humidity well over 100%. George leads an Explorers Club Flag Expedition into the cave, wearing special refrigerated suits and respirators to battle the extreme environment.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death. At several points during this extraordinary enquiry, police will feel they're holding the culprit... It will take them ten years to finally shed light on this particularly violent crime.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. A veritable execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of the quiet family man. Yet behind the appearances, the investigation gradually reveals all the hate and resentment that revolved around the victim.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death. At several points during this extraordinary enquiry, police will feel they're holding the culprit... It will take them ten years to finally shed light on this particularly violent crime.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. A veritable execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of the quiet family man. Yet behind the appearances, the investigation gradually reveals all the hate and resentment that revolved around the victim.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of a four year old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "Mecum Auctions, Houston, Texas"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Mecum Auctions, Houston, Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Learning to win"
programme.desc: We discover 2 ways of achieving success: The wild talent of the young Jack Miller, and the perfectionist tenacity of Tito Rabat.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Dynasties: Like father like son"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Dynasties: Like father like son
programme.desc: We witness Randy Mamola and Wayne Gardner’s reunion, along side their successors: their sons Dakota y Remy.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "To Hell and Back"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Last year's champion, Erik Miller defends his title. While 2nd place finisher, Jason Scherer, will be one of the many top challengers aiming to beat him.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Finding the Line"
programme.desc: We follow Shannon Campbell, the first 3-time champion of the King of the Hammers. But his kids, also young drivers, push their dad to the brink of his limits.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Driver Changes"
programme.desc: It’s week four and the contestants are preparing for a new round of challenges...and for our eight remaining rookies the elimination room looms.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Eyes on the Prize"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Eyes on the Prize
programme.desc: In a surprise twist, a special guest judge will deal out some honest truths to the remaining rookies. Who will be sent home tonight?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Postie"
programme.desc: The rookies take on their first challenge involving a zippy Honda postie bike.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S1 - "Garage 59 - McLaren 650S"
programme.desc: In this profile, we get to know Garage 59 competing in a McLaren 650S at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa race held at the Spa-Francorchamps circuit.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: A Canadian MTB adventurer explores Madagascar and shows the behind the scenes processes of making a film.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Norway"
programme.desc: An Irish MTB pro rider discovers and rides the most amazing trails that Norway has to offer from the mountains to the ocean.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Alaska"
programme.desc: We follow one of the best MTB riders and trail-builders on the planet during a trip in Alaska, one of the most remote and wild places in the world.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "Will Gets Grumpy"
programme.desc: Dave brings in his own engine to test run. The Ghouls fine tune Torino’s GTX and Mark and Alyssa meet a client with a special car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "Phantom's 440 Six Barrel"
programme.desc: Will takes a protege in the paint booth. Mark explains the suspension on a Mopar and Will and Alyssa struggle with the billboard graphic.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "Cap'ing-off the Challenger"
programme.desc: Dave and Alyssa install a radiator. The dashboard is installed in the gold charger and Mark applies the RoadRunner’s iconic decals.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel: The Renovation Diaries
programme.desc: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930’s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record. This documentary follows the events from restoration to record day.

programme.title: Franco
programme.desc: Franco Morbidelli enters MotoGP as Moto2 World Champion. Now, the graduate of Valentino Rossi’s Riders Academy could be set for a debut to remember.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Thirteen"
programme.desc: Nik explores BMW's electrified future. Mike off-roads in the Nissan Titan Pro-4X. Cadillac shines with the new Escalade. Nik highlights Toyota Tundra's value. He enjoys the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "The thin line to success"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The thin line to success
programme.desc: We'll walk the fine line to success: from Alberto Puig's life changing accident, to the astonishing sponsorship deal of the Laglisse Champions’ Squad.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "So Near, So Far"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 So Near, So Far
programme.desc: We reveal how Maverick & Alvaro face the loneliness of being Champions: Maverick lets go of family support while for Alvaro Bautista, family is the key.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Race Against or Share With?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Race Against or Share With?
programme.desc: We discover the relationship between Brad and Darryn Binder, 2 brothers who race against each other on motorcycle tracks around the world.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "Malicious Intent"
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "1975 Corvette"
programme.desc: Vinnie is working on replacing the gages on this 1975 Corvette. The rocker panels on the 1964 Corvette are ready to be reinstalled.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Car Control"
programme.desc: Being a successful V8 Supercar driver means more than just driving, you need to be the whole package...This week the contestants will learn why communication is an important skill to master.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Simulated Race"
programme.desc: Our rookies are transported to an unknown location – leaving our nervous contestants wondering “what’s next?”

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "V8 Supercar"
programme.desc: The remaining rookies are en-route to Winton where they will test the Supercar Showdown V8 for the very first time. What will they think of the car once it's revealed?

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Collision Course"
programme.desc: Jimmy’s final practice sessions lead to breakdowns and panic, while Bruce races to adapt his truck mid-race.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Mechanical Meltdown"
programme.desc: As fuel shortages and mechanical failures threaten to end their race, tensions rise. Will they overcome the chaos and keep the dream alive?

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Dark of the Desert"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Dark of the Desert
programme.desc: The pressure intensifies as the team pushes further into the Baja 1000. Mechanical failures, punctured tires, and navigational setbacks challenge their endurance.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S1 - "The Pro Drivers"
programme.desc: In this profile, we get to know the Pro Drivers competing at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa race held at the Spa-Francorchamps circuit.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S2 - "Staying out of trouble"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Staying out of trouble
programme.desc: In this episode, we experience the beginning of the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa together with some of the most promising teams aiming for victory.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S2 - "Surviving the Night"
programme.desc: In this episode, we learn that driving at night requires specific driving skills and consequently accidents are severe at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Britz Base Camp"
programme.desc: Before the rookies can claim the ultimate prize – a testing contract with Team Honda Racing and $20,000 - they must complete a challenging dirt skills session.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Slow Speed"
programme.desc: To test the rookies’ fundamental skills of accelerating, braking, and cornering, Moto GP legend Daryl Beattie and Team Honda Racing boss Paul Free have designed both a skills session and a points challenge.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "21st Birthday"
programme.desc: Which contestant can get the furthest on 500ml of fuel while maintaining a set race speed? Can Glenn take out top spot and receive the best birthday present he could ask for?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "67 Hemi GTX Convertible Resurrected"
programme.sub-title: S06 : E12 67 Hemi GTX Convertible Resurrected
programme.desc: The Ghouls test drive Torino’s GTX. Royal and Dave do some detailing and a devilish plan is hatched to fool Mark.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Bringing Out The Big Guns"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Bringing Out The Big Guns
programme.desc: It's mud, sweat, and gears as drivers battle it out in the toughest Ultra 4 race yet.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "California Metal Stampede"
programme.desc: It's all or nothing as underdog Tom Liu drives himself to the brink in a heart-stopping Ultra 4 race.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Dmitrij Sribnyj"
programme.desc: Dmitrij Sribnyj reveals his story for the first time from his evacuation during the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear disaster to becoming a 4-time Gymkhana Grid champion.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Luke Woodham v Adam Elder"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Luke Woodham v Adam Elder
programme.desc: 3-time rear wheel drive Gymkhana Grid champion Luke Woodham is defending for a fourth title. His biggest rival Adam Elder is doing everything he can to win.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode One"
programme.desc: Nik showcases the BMW 4 series design and discusses car tech evolution. Mike explores the BMW US Motorcycle Academy. Nik highlights the Cadillac CT5. They reveal recent advancements in pick-up trucks.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Two"
programme.desc: Nik presents the lavish Rolls Royce Ghost, praises the 2021 Chevy Trailblazer, showcases Genesis' new arrivals, and introduces Chevrolet's Bolt EUV and EV.

programme.title: Franco
programme.desc: Franco Morbidelli enters MotoGP as Moto2 World Champion. Now, the graduate of Valentino Rossi’s Riders Academy could be set for a debut to remember.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel: Return of the Riley
programme.desc: Can the team behind Kestrel Beer and one of the world’s best drag racing engineers break multiple land speed records in a 1930s Kestrel Riley classic car?

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Morgan"
programme.desc: Mat’s demanding client Gordon is in search of a Morgan, but will he be able to find the ideal car for the right price?

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Citroen DS"
programme.desc: Mat goes in search of a perfect Citroen DS for Leon, a man who has strong connections to the DS, and to France.

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Mini"
programme.desc: Mat Watson travels Europe on the trail of a very special 1960s Mini.

programme.title: Fast and Famous S1 - "Fast and Famous"
programme.desc: Racing Driver Arie Luyendyk Jr. challenges two celebrities, kickboxer Rico Verhoeven and footballer Sol Campbell, to see who is the fastest around the track.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Fatal Finale"
programme.desc: Will they defy the odds and cross the finish line, or will the desert claim another dream? With everything on the line, this is the moment that will define their legacy.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S2 - "Being There at the End"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Being There at the End
programme.desc: In this episode, we discover that spirit and tactics for real endurance teams become vital in order to claim victory at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S3 - "Through the Night"
programme.desc: The 24 Hours of Spa is a notoriously difficult race. For Andy Soucek, Albert Costa and Lewis Williamson, making it through night presents a tough challenge.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "72 Charger SE Resurrected"
programme.desc: Will & Alyssa struggle with the billboard graphic. Mark finishes a suspension and the car that started the show rolls again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Grin and Bear a ‘Cuda"
programme.sub-title: S07 : E01 Grin and Bear a ‘Cuda
programme.desc: In the season 7 debut, it's all about the 'Cudas. The ghouls get cracking on the infamous '71 Phantom Cuda and Mark gets three new Barracudas delivered.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Operation Firepower?"
programme.desc: Mark announces a top-secret project to the ghouls and Allysa surprises her dad, when she manages to get him his old car for Father’s Day

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Brazil"
programme.desc: The World’s best Brazilian rider opens the doors to his house to show how it all started and brings us to Mexico for the most famous urban race in the world.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Argentina"
programme.desc: Two talented Canadian brothers and pro MTB riders decide to go on a freeride trip together and choose to explore the remote desert of Argentina.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "South Africa"
programme.desc: We follow the fastest and most stylish female MTB pro rider in the world during a trip to South Africa where she will ride the best trails around Cape Town.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Brains and Brawn"
programme.desc: Being a successful motorbike racer takes more than a need for speed. Today the rookies’ brains AND brawn are tested, in skills and points challenges designed to stretch them to the limit.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Throttle Control"
programme.desc: It’s getting to the pointy end of the competition in The Ultimate Rider - and failure this week will could bring embarrassment as well as pain.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Semi Final"
programme.desc: It’s semi final time for The Ultimate Rider contestants and, after seven weeks away from family and friends, tensions run high and the competition gets fierce!

programme.title: FMX Nomads S1 - "FMX Nomads"
programme.desc: Join Dan Whitby, Samson Eaton and Arran Powley for a day in the life of globetrotting freestyle motocross team, Bolddog.

programme.title: Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream S1 - "Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream
programme.desc: Alex Hirschi started her own vlog reviewing the world’s most exclusive and expensive supercars and her meteoric rise has seen her gain millions of followers and her very own TV Series.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Pagoda"
programme.desc: The team does a restoration modification of a 1964 Mercedes Benz 230 SL, adding custom made wheels and a modern engine.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Blazer"
programme.desc: A 1970 K5 Chevrolet Blazer undergoes a transformation with new paint, interior, and a diesel engine conversion.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Shelly"
programme.desc: A neglected 1981 Porsche 911 SC is brought back to life and restored to its original factory specifications.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "It is what it is.."
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 It is what it is..
programme.desc: Team Indiana, the underdogs of Ultra 4, take the fight to the enemy.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Great 8"
programme.desc: Road to Gymkhana Grid: 100% pure adrenalin! Profiling 8 of the sport’s top drivers, we see into their minds and the mental preparation needed to compete.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Against All Odds"
programme.desc: Engine failures, last-minute fixes, and a shoestring budget threaten their shot before it even begins, leaving everyone to wonder: can sheer determination outrun the looming disaster?

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Oil and Uncertainty"
programme.desc: With race day looming, the pressure erupts. Can untested modifications and raw determination carry them to the starting line—or will the Baja’s harsh terrain break them first?

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Miami"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie is given the keys to a five million dollar Pagani Huayra L’Ultimo as she explores the sub-culture of lowriders with the seal of approval from Horacio Pagani himself. Will she be accepted into this tribe?

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Detroit"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie arrives in ‘Motor City’ in the dead of winter but given access to a half million dollar new Ford GT raises her spirits. Her goal is to learn more about muscle cars, born in Detroit, and her journey takes her in different directions.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "64 Corvette resto mod"
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas take you on a tour of what is happening in the shop. Replacing the front end of a 64 Corvette resto mod. Painting racing stripes on a 67 442 convertible. A yellow Camaro underneath the hood of this car.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "442 resto mod"
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas work on gluing the front panel on the 442 Restomod. This 67 Mercury Cougar has some issues with the rear brake pads.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "One Final Challenge"
programme.desc: It’s D-Day. After eight grueling weeks of competition, one very talented rookie will stand atop the podium and take the crown and a $20,000 prize and a dream contract with Team Honda Racing.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi"
programme.sub-title: S07 : E04 This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi
programme.desc: The 1 of a kind 1969 Hemi Roadrunner Convertible, is back on the lift. With the owner soon to arrive, the ghouls have to ramp up and get it finished.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Judgement Day"
programme.desc: Tony and Cindy D'Agostino visit the Ghouls. Mark and Tony geek out over the 1970 Superbee 383 Magnum and the 1971 Plymouth Roadrunner.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7 - "Cuda ‘Tat"
programme.desc: Mark and Allysa decode the broadcast sheet for a 1970 Challenger. Will breaks a part on the 'Cuda and Mark painstakingly examines his paint job.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Three"
programme.desc: Nik unveils the bold Cadillac Escalade, while Mike praises the redesigned Nissan Rogue. Nik shares Alfa Romeo's rich 110-year legacy, then cruises in the Lexus LC500 with the top down.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Four"
programme.desc: Nik tests the 2021 Toyota Land Cruiser. Mike explores the 2021 Kia Telluride. Nik showcases the 2021 Hyundai N Line. Witness Mercedes Benz AMG's pinnacle creation. Nik's blown away by the new Kia K5.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Five"
programme.desc: Nik showcases Mercedes-Benz's screen innovation. Mike loves the 2021 Kia Seltos. They both enjoy driving cool cars like the 2021 Corvette Stingray. Nik praises the 2021 Toyota Venza Hybrid.

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Mercedes SL"
programme.desc: Mat Watson tracks down one of the most desirable convertibles on the planet. The Mercedes SL Pagoda.

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "American Car"
programme.desc: Mat Watson sets off to seek out a slice of Americana. A classic car from the USA.

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Volvo P1800"
programme.desc: Mat Watson hunts throughout Europe for a classy Nordic coupe. The Volvo P1800.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Cabriolet"
programme.desc: A ruined and rested family heirloom 1962 Mercedes Benz 220 SE Cabriolet gets a restoration modification with a new Mercedes engine and a new interior with heated seats.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 3.5"
programme.desc: A rare 1971 Mercedes Benz 280 SE 3.5 Coupe gets restored to its original specifications.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Pinky"
programme.desc: A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom built engine, new paint, and new wheels and tires.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Blood, Sweat and Gears"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Blood, Sweat and Gears
programme.desc: Handsome Jay Callaway's racing career is on the line in one of the toughest technical East Coast race of the series.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "The Outsider"
programme.desc: Wayland Campbell and Levi Shirley go head to head leading to the championship but there is an outsider Randy Slawson, 2 time champion to never under-estimate.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "The Showdown"
programme.desc: Leaders Wayland Campbell and Levi Shirley push each other to their limits while other top drivers show just how fast 4x4 off road racing has become.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "All for Bike"
programme.desc: Sacrifices are found on the path to success: from Yonny Hernandez’s self-exile, to the serious injuries that Doctor Villamor has to treat.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Ken Block"
programme.desc: Founder of The Gymkhana Grid and viral superstar, Ken Block, gives a detailed account of the creation of one of the fastest growing events in the world.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Shane Lynch"
programme.desc: The world-famous Boyzone band is back on tour but for Shane Lynch, his true passion is motorsport. He hangs up his microphone and gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Petter Solberg"
programme.desc: 2-time WRX champion Petter Solberg gives a master class in drift driving. Defending his first Gymkhana Grid win, Petter is force to up his game.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Morocco"
programme.desc: A German MTB legend decides to build a van and travel all the way down to Morocco to explore and ride the great Atlas mountains.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Spain"
programme.desc: We meet with a Spanish MTB pro rider who decided to create his own company in order to build the most exclusive and unique carbon bikes.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Bali"
programme.desc: We travel to Bali - Indonesia to meet an MTB pro rider who decided to start a new life dividing his time between surfing and riding active volcanos.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "1963 Corvette Z06"
programme.desc: The team at Muscle Cars of Texas will add primer to the frame of a half million dollar 1963 Corvette Z06. This 65 Mustang had a tune up and its ready for a test drive. A new costumer has dropped off a 1968 Corvette for a restoration project.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "59 Ford Pickup"
programme.desc: This time, on Muscle Cars of Texas, Vinnie and the team are working on a 63 Z06, 59 Ford Pickup and a 69 Chevy Malibu.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "69 Chevy Malibu"
programme.desc: Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas go under the hood of the 69 Malibu. The 63 Z06 factory race car, you have to see what it takes to make this race car look like it came out of the factory. Tagging and bagging time on the 72 Corvette.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Dirt Vs Road"
programme.desc: The Ultimate Rider will need to master both dirt and road surfaces to claim top spot. And, surprise eliminations could end their dream at any time. Could someone go home after just one day?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Queen of the Dirt"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Queen of the Dirt
programme.desc: We finally get to see the rookies hit the dirt track for the first time, and the game changes. Who will take top points and announce themselves as the one to beat, and who will crumble under the pressure?

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Indonesia, Greece, Syria, Thailand
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Indonesia - Tomato Nasi Goreng, Greece - Greek Melon Salad, Syria - Kidney Bean Hummus, and Thailand - Coconut Curry Cabbage Rolls!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa and Stefania plan an afternoon tea with a table to match! There’s tea sandwiches, scones with jam and clotted cream, mini quiche, Steffy’s banana cake, and so much more!

programme.title: The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen ditches regular butter for a fruit butter as she bakes a beautiful apple butter turnover with pecans and gorgonzola.

programme.title: Generation Cooks
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with vegetables, Liam whips up his favorite breakfast - homemade egg bites, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make airy plantain beignets!

programme.title: Everyday Excellent
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a quick weekday meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: zucchini with balsamic and goat cheese, a rotini bake, and microwave lemon mug cakes!

programme.title: Bring On The Karbs
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 Long and the Short of It
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the most tantalizing meal featuring long and short ingredients! Josh makes a long sandwich, long grain rice, and a Long Island iced tea in a short glass, while Erica prepares long pepper short ribs, short grain rice, long beans, and long noodles!

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience; Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served...

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Mavericks"

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Jamaica"
