programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Detroit"
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Munich"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace discovers Munich’s Bavarian food and history over 3 days, revealing how the region helped shape Germany.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Mysore: The Rebel Kingdom"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Mysore: The Rebel Kingdom
programme.desc: Journeys explores the history and fables that surround the controversial rebel leader Tipu Sultan. Mysore was the center of an Empire strong enough to challenge the British.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Nagarhole and Bandipur: The Southern Paradise of India"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Nagarhole and Bandipur: The Southern Paradise of India
programme.desc: From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer’s paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises
programme.desc: Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: The Luxe Travels season starts off in the beautiful and highly popular tourism hotspot; Bali. The host, Liesel Hlista embarks on a mission to understand how the Balinese blend hospitality with luxury.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: An uncommon destination for a series that explores exotic tropical getaways. But this island nation has some of the most evocative landscapes that mother nature has to offer!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Jamaica"
programme.desc: Easy island vibes, lots of amazing local rum, brilliant natural landscapes and those amazing beaches! Of course,Luxe Travels is in Jamaica! But in this episode, host Liesel Hlista shows you a different side of the Irie nation; away from the hordes of people unleashed via cruise liners!

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He’s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Desert Survival"
programme.desc: Ash heads into the desert to meet up with Wu Xinlei, who is a survival expert. He’s hoping to understand what it would have been like for the people who built The Great Wall in this remote and punishing landscape.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Crescent Lake"
programme.desc: Ash is into the final stretch of his journey along The Great Wall of China. After seeing the building techniques used on the Great Wall, Ash heads into the Gobi Desert to the stunning Cresent Lake – a beautiful oasis between walls of sand.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Seattle"
programme.desc: Denella visits the Emerald City, Seattle. This gateway city is known for it's award winning airport and cruise port.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Alaska"
programme.desc: Denella visits Anchorage, Alaska, where it's a bit urban and wild.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Disney Cruise Line"
programme.desc: Sail away with Denella on board the Disney Dream. Who says Disney Cruise Line is just for kids?

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Mildura, Vienna, Hahndorf"
programme.desc: Join Alana as she visits her home town of Mildura and then onto the beautiful Austrian capital Vienna. Scotty heads up north to the Western Australian pearl town of Broome and Skye explores the delicacies of Hahndorf, South Australia.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Vienna, Broome, Barossa Valley"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Vienna, Broome, Barossa Valley
programme.desc: Alana visits the fresh food market in Vienna and Scotty tucks into one of Broome’s signature dishes. Skye’s in the historic town of Hahndorf and learns about its German heritage before visiting Australia’s premium wine region of the Barossa Valley.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "New South Wales, Budapest"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 New South Wales, Budapest
programme.desc: Scotty visits the New South Wales south coast while Alana continues her European tour in Budapest while Skye tries her hand at golf in the world-renowned wine region of the Barossa Valley.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Panna: Land of the Dhole"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Panna: Land of the Dhole
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Ahmedabad: Land of Gandhi"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Ahmedabad: Land of Gandhi
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Calcutta: City of Living History"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Calcutta: City of Living History
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Puerto Rico"
programme.desc: Liesel explores all the hands-on activities such as riding horseback on the beach, riding ATV’s through the muddy swamps, and hiking through the super lush El Yunque rainforest. Luxurious resorts are only a stone's throw away - hopping islands, Liesel gets to experience the ultra modern and chic El Blok located in Vieques. Between stays at all the luxury boutique resorts, a common trend starts to appear, and that is the island’s cuisine.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Hong Kong"

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Belize"

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "York"

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Hard Rock Tampa"

After a few bike troubles, Jess and her team arrive in Delhi, reflecting on the unforgettable journey they've shared together.

programme.desc: Renowned winter photographer, Tristan Shu, attempts his dream project; a photograph that combines astrophotography with action sports. His aim is to capture ski and snowboard tricks at night, set against the Milky-way and the spectacular Mont-Blanc.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 2"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson backpacks along the spectacular Saguenay Fjord, before setting out on a paddling adventure in Québec’s Laurentian mountains.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 3"

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 6"

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - "Snowdonia"

programme.desc: Jason loves mountain biking. Tayler prefers to read a book. Jason is up for any adventure tossed at him. Tayler likes to be a bit more prepared. Will the adventures that await in Arkansas leave the couple questioning if they have anything in common?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Theodora's Room"
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason travel to Eureka Springs, AR, a town with a rich history and home to one of the most haunted hotels in America, The Crescent. Jason convinces Tayler to stay one night, but will that stay lead to a night they don't want to remember?

programme.desc: Chris is going underground; from the caves of Coober Pedy to accommodation with a difference in the Blue mountains.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Valentine's Day"
programme.desc: Chris helps a friend arrange a romantic Valentines Day for his partner and gives viewers the run down of his top five most romantic Australian beaches.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Melbourne"

programme.title: Running the World S1 - "Gran Canaria"

This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. Chengdu lacquerware also emphasizes the use of vibrant colors. Pieces are brought to beautiful life by bright red, vivid yellow, emerald green, and other striking hues.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Selected Programs From the 2026 CMG Spring Festival Gala
programme.desc: The Spring Festival, or Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional holiday for Chinese people. Additionally, watching the Spring Festival Gala is a cherished part of the celebrations across hundreds of millions of Chinese homes.Since first being broadcast in 1983, the gala has been recognized by the Guinness World Records as the most-watched annual television program on the planet. Just over a year ago, the Spring Festival itself was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Selected Programs From the 2026 CMG Spring Festival Gala
programme.desc: The Spring Festival, or Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional holiday for Chinese people. Additionally, watching the Spring Festival Gala is a cherished part of the celebrations across hundreds of millions of Chinese homes.Since first being broadcast in 1983, the gala has been recognized by the Guinness World Records as the most-watched annual television program on the planet. Just over a year ago, the Spring Festival itself was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council.The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been...

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit.It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Last preps

Things are still tense between Kim and her parents. Her father blames here for having left school too early and the family makes no effort to hide their dislike of Pierre, the would-be father, who is still a no-show. They go as far as opposing Kim’s preferred choice for the future boy’s name, since it was his father that came up with the idea...

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Welcome in a new world

In the end, it is Nathalie and Naoufel, our most experienced parents, who share with us some words of wisdom: “one isn’t just born being a parent, one has to learn it.”

We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals. Her love for creating art while respecting nature turned into a drive to seek out sustainable vegetable dyes.Today, her artwork and craft are intertwined as she makes beautiful prints and motifs that she colours with natural dyes, prepared from handpicked variety of flowers and plants that turn into stunning creations.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 2 - So the great rivers may live - Part 2
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 So the great rivers may live - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand thus continues his world tour and his inventory of the planet with the great rivers that suffer from man's excesses as a common thread. " So the great rivers may live" is the discovery of places, men and women who are fighting so that our waterways simply have their place on Earth. Thanks to his genius, man is correcting his mistakes: the Aral Sea, which once disappeared, is coming back. In New York, millions of people have drinking water thanks to the natural virtues of the forest.

programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll...

programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Jessica
programme.desc: Jessica’s life as a teenager was marked by a family tragedy that she struggled to cope with for a long time. Her anxiety had reached an all-time high and she was experiencing regular panic attacks when finally, she discovered surfing. This newfound passion thoroughly changed her lifestyle, ultimately resulting in a move to Bali, Indonesia. Today, she runs mindful surf & yoga retreats while also working online as a wellness writer.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Lisa & Pete
programme.desc: Two urbanites surprise themselves by changing their city lifestyles for farm living : Lisa, an architect based in London, and her husband Pete, an actor seen in Hollywoodian movies such as “Ghost in the Shell” alongside Scarlett Johansson and a rock star in his own right in his native Malaysia. Together, they figured they were far from being ready for retirement. Instead, they dove headfirst into running an organic farm where they now both thrive while taking pleasure in returning to a simpler life.

The dangers of moving around in such a metropolis are exacerbated for a blind person. Despite this, Jose Alfredo embarks on a 2-hour journey every day, relying solely on his intuition, his cane, and the help of his little brother.

programme.title: Ways to School - Season 1 - Obdulia, Mexico
programme.desc: Obdulia González Fierro is 9 years old, she lives with her parents and brothers in the imposing and desolate Sierra Tarahumara. To get to the religious boarding school in which she receives a formal education, Obdulia and her friend Irma have to travel 6 hours. They walk for 3 hours and spend 3 more on a truck. Along the way they encounter dangers like poisonous snakes and unstable trails in mountains that are over 2,000 meters high.

There, women and men manage to protect wildlife every day.

Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY returns to the US with a four-man Middleweight Tournament to decide the GLORY Middleweight title. Plus two lightweight match ups with Robin van Roosmalen taking on Shemsi Beqiri and Davit Kiria meeting Murthel Groenhart.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer...

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) will put his GLORY welterweight title on the line against ‘House of GLORY’ winner Anwar Ouled-Chaib (3-0) in the main event. In the co-main event, local fan favourite Nabil Khachab (26-4-1, 4 KO) finally gets his opportunity to enter the GLORY Grand Prix as he goes up against Serbia’s Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) in a qualifying fight. Number one ranked Enriko Kehl (52-15-2, 30 KO) will be aiming undeniably book his spot as the next title challenger against champion Tyjani Beztati. The German meets the dangerous Arman Hambaryan (58-8-2, 27 KO) of Armenia.

Their paths cross when Mehek participates in a cooking competition that Shaurya is judging. The show blends themes of love, family, and ambition with a strong emphasis on culinary arts.

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Golden One Center - Sacramento, CA
programme.desc: Experience the raw power of the Arena Championship Series West as Monster Jam Replay takes over the Golden One Center in Sacramento, California. Round 4 features high-stakes action starting with JCB Racing, where Armando Castro and El Toro Loco battle through the bracket to defeat Carson Williams in Thunderoarus for the racing title. The excitement continues with the Great Clips Skills Challenge, featuring technical maneuvers and two-wheel stunts. The night reaches its peak during Freestyle, where Blake Granger and Monster Mutt Dalmatian deliver a spectacular performance, including a signature backflip, to sweep the competition. After a fierce battle against top competitors like Matt Cody...

programme.title: Monster Jam Fast Track
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Snapdragon Stadium - San Diego, CA
programme.desc: High-speed brackets and split-second decisions define this Monster Jam Fast Track showdown as elite drivers push their trucks to the limit in racing and skills competition. Tyler Menninga’s Grave Digger sets the tone early, but relentless pressure from Zombie, El Toro Loco, Megalodon, and Vendetta turns every run into a must-win moment. Clean launches, aggressive cornering, and costly mistakes reshape the leaderboard as rivals trade momentum. With points on the line and no room for error, this episode delivers pure Monster Jam intensity from start to finish.

programme.desc: Like it or not - we're a nation of speeders, and we need all the help we can get. So in this episode of Fifth Gear Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson are going to help you save your licence.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson risks life and limb in the most dangerous car stunt of all - driving a car under a moving lorry. Jonny Smith tests the new Mercedes C Class and its revolutionary seat design.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar, Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world, and Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motorshow.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki finds out what's quickest in the Shoot-Out feature - the brand new Audi S5 or the BMW 335i; England rugby star Kyran Bracken is given some circuit driving tuition from Jason Plato; Jonny Smith tests a potential revolution in city transport

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5. It's the best selling sportscar in the world, but have Mazda fixed something that wasn't broken.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford takes a look at the new Lexus IS 250, and Vicki heads to the track for a special estate shoot out. But who will rise victorious, the Volvo or Subaru?

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell meets some of the people whose lives have been blighted by a terror of driving. He then considers the latest solutions to the problem.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Adrian Simpson test drives Volvo's new off-roader. He concludes because of their attention to safety, the environment and the family-size accommodation Volvo have created a different kind of 4x4.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell reports on fifth Gear's project to build a 200mph car. Last time we saw our Lotus it blew up in a cloud of smoke, but it's back, repaired, and even more modified.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff puts the latest Caterham through its paces in an unusual test. Tom drives Seat's brand new family saloon - the Exeo. Jonny invents three practical tests for the brand-new Nissan Pixo. Jason gets to enjoy the Lamborghini LP670-4 Super Veloce.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom drives the brand new Kia Soul - the most ambitious car from the Korean manufacturer to date. Vicki takes part in a trackday to demonstrate just how capable the BMW 330d is. Tiff brings us another stunning view of motorsport culture in Abu Dhabi.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: We find out what happens if you accidentally put diesel into a petrol engine, and follow Tiff Needell as he races an Aston Martin DBR9S.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Fifth Gear Quentin Willson and Tiff Needell stage a massive head-on collision by piloting two remote controlled cars into each other at 60 mph.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Fifth Gear Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the world's biggest lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato races two estates head to head. Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf. Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less. Tiff Needell runs Fifth Gear's most exciting car v bike race to date.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff heads to Anglesey to see what's quickest; a Smart Brabus or Mini Cooper S when they get pitched head to head in the Fifth Gear shoot out.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato gets a world's first test drive in the £380,000 Pagani Zonda F. Vicki Butler-Henderson heads to our Anglesey test track to race a Porsche 911 against the latest Lotus Exige.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tim Shaw tests whether the claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not. Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches. Tiff Needell has the first TV test of the world's first underwater car, the Rinspeed Squba.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: We pit the Ford Sierra Cosworth and the Mercedes 190E Cosworth against each other. Tim in London investigates the new craze of car share clubs. Tiff drives the brand new Nissan 370Z around what used to be one of the fastest race circuits in Europe.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta. Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels. Jonny shows us three great, affordable cars. Jason Plato takes the Porsche 911 GT2 out on the track.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: We all assume that driving around in a big SUV means we're protected and safe - but do you know what it would take to get one to topple over?

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford tests the latest version of the car that is perennially voted one of Britain's favourite cars - the Land Rover Defender. Jonny Smith celebrates Ferrari's 60th Birthday.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell sets out to see whether it's possible to drive along the A537 from Macclesfield to Buxton, the most dangerous road in Britain, safely in the first Porsche Cayman in the country.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell has a tough assignment. Our selfless road tester has to fly to Nice to drive the ultimate Mercedes-Benz, the flagship of the range, the £120,000 plus CL65.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: An exclusive insight into America's most glamorous supercar club, based in an underground bunker at a private jet airport, Tiff Needell and Jason Plato race the BMW M3 against the Audi RS4.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track - the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z. Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton. Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki tests two cars that are low, light and very fast - Lotus Exige S v Caterham CSR. Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Landcruiser. Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black. Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of powersliding.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell tests the new Lamborghini Murcielago and finds it slightly less inspiring than Lamborghinis of old - slightly less of a raw supercar.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: In a superb world first, Tiff Needell gets to drive a Williams Formula 1 Grand Prix car. With exclusive access to the team we're allowed to follow Tiff every step of the way.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell is joined by Le Mans winner Guy Smith and former rally co-driver Tony Mason to do something that's not as ridiculous as it might sound - caravan racing.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff and Jason celebrate the 100th anniversary of Aston Martin. Jason drives James Bond's DB5 from Skyfall and learns from the the master craftsmen at the company's heritage centre, while Tiff tests the brand new Rapide S four door supercar

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: The GR Yaris is an iconic Hot Hatch of the modern era. To see if it earns this credit, Jason Plato puts it up against two equally iconic classic cars.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson races in an event that's the first step to becoming a rally champion, Jonny Smith drives a brand new version of one of Britain's most important cars.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell race a pair of high tech supercars, Vicki Butler-Henderson tests BMW's glamorous new convertible in Spain, Jonny gives a beginner's guide to the iconic Nurburgring.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell and Formula E racing driver Karun Chandhok put two supercar fast limos up against each other on the track - the Mercedes S63 AMG and Jaguar XJR. The team test the Citroen C4 Cactus, a car with airbags on outside.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un cambriolage dans un quartier huppé mobilise toutes les jeunes recrues, mais une fois la scène inspectée, Andy se retrouve seule face à un voleur caché, armé et particulièrement instable.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une collision mortelle révèle une vérité choquante, et la romance entre Andy et l'inspecteur Luke Callaghan se complique lorsqu'ils sont en désaccord sur la manière de traiter un témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur fait des ravages, sans compter la présence d'un violeur en série. Dans ce chaos, une panne de courant générale force Andy à s'attaquer seule à ce dangereux prédateur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Chris enquêtent sur une agression, mais quand tous les indices mènent à un policier, ils doivent prendre une décision qui pourrait mettre leur carrière en péril.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Girlfriend of the Year
programme.desc: Chris et Gail découvrent une voiture accidentée correspondant à une alerte enlèvement. Une chasse à l'homme débute et l'interrogatoire des parents de l’enfant révèle des indices troublants.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La tension est palpable entre Andy et Swarek, mais ils doivent mettre leurs sentiments de côté lorsqu'un transfert de prisonnier qui tourne mal finit en chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 To Serve or Protect
programme.desc: Le père d'Andy, ancien flic, pense avoir commis un crime durant un trou de mémoire dû à l'alcool, et en se penchant sur l'affaire, elle est confrontée à l'éventualité de l'envoyer en prison.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: C'est le jour de l'évaluation pour les recrues, qui vont connaître l'avenir réservé à leur carrière. Mais le meurtre d'une jeune fille bouleverse Andy qui songe à rendre son insigne.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une arrestation prématurée compromet une importante saisie de drogue, Andy tente de s'infiltrer avec Swarek. Mais un changement de plan radical met leur vie en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La vie d'Andy bascule quand elle reçoit une balle perdue lors d'une fusillade qui ôte la vie à une étudiante. En cherchant une explication, Andy entre en conflit avec une nouvelle détective.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Gail jouent les serveuses afin de démanteler un trafic de drogue, Traci lutte contre ses sentiments pour Jerry, et Dov et Chris entrent en désaccord concernant une plainte.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un vol de têtes coupées, Andy et Swarek retrouvent la trace d'un homme mentalement instable, et exposent malencontreusement Luke à de terribles conséquences.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une série d'incendies frappe une laverie. Chris et Gail rencontrent un homme lié au passé de Chris, Traci interroge une jeune incendiaire, et Andy se retrouve piégée dans les flammes.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un criminel donne une info qui pousse Dov et Chris dans une maison piégée. Traci et Andy font ce qu'elles peuvent pour une suspecte SDF. Luke et Jo travaillent ensemble sur une surveillance.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un informateur est retrouvé assassiné. Andy fait équipe avec l'inspectrice Jo Rosati, qui semble bien intéressée par Luke. Gail doit protéger un jeune témoin qui cache un lourd secret.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Une femme est agressée à l'identique qu'une recrue décédée, et Luke Callaghan est sûr qu'il s'agit du même suspect. Mais comme on lui retire l'affaire, il convainc Andy de suivre sa théorie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division est sous quarantaine. Andy et Swarek cherchent le complice d'un braqueur. Gail a été exposée à un malade, Chris infiltre une cellule et Dov a rendez-vous avec une démineuse.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov et Gail tentent d'empêcher un gang chinois d'assassiner un mouchard. Andy et Chris rejoignent les recrues de la 27ème Division lors d'un entraînement équin pour le moins compétitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La traque d'un ravisseur mène la 15e Division sur les lieux d'un accident de voiture. Pendant qu'Andy s'occupe d'une femme coincée dans sa voiture, les autres agents poursuivent le fugitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, Traci et Andy tombent sur une femme faisant une overdose, et Dov rencontre un vieil ami. Chris et Gail s'occupent d'un adolescent retrouvé ligoté dans un cimetière.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait voler son uniforme. Swarek tente d'obtenir des informations d'un ancien membre de la police criminelle, mais son incapacité à rester éloigné d'Andy compromet l'opération.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que Swarek est violemment interrogé par Jamie Brennan dans le sous-sol d'une ferme, les recrues aident Andy à résoudre un mystère qui pourrait révéler l'endroit où il se trouve.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle se rend à son audience, Andy, toujours suspendue, fait le lien entre une jeune fille qui disparaît mystérieusement du lieu d'un accident et une ancienne affaire non résolue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les lycées s'apprêtent à fermer pour l'été, une voiture de police armée est volée. Andy et Swarek recherchent un adolescent instable qui a agressé le père de sa petite amie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov est témoin d'un vol et abat un jeune adolescent noir. A-t-il fait usage d'une force justifiable ? Quand la nouvelle se répand dans le quartier, les choses s'enveniment.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une voiture remplie de jeunes filles percute un autre véhicule et tue la conductrice. Quand Jerry découvre que l'autre conducteur était mort avant l'accident, il retire l'affaire à Traci.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Andy se retrouve obligée de travailler en étroite collaboration avec sa mère qui l'a abandonnée, Swarek, Nick, Chris et Gail recherchent une mère de famille désespérée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Swarek découvrent un SDF poignardé et un témoin surprenant : Izzy, la fille d'Oliver, âgée de 15 ans. Son implication pousse Oliver à la frontière entre son rôle de père et de flic.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un soi-disant médium veut aider la 15e Division à retrouver un témoin dans une affaire de crime organisé, les policiers se retrouvent confrontés à certaines vérités cachées.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une enquête sur une série de disparitions d'escort-girls, Gail part en infiltration. Mais Dov et Chris découvrent qu'il s'agit de l'œuvre d'un tueur qui pourrait s'en prendre à Gail.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait enlever par un possible tueur en série. En suivant les pistes d'affaires similaires, les agents retrouvent les traces du meurtrier, mais sont contraints de faire un sacrifice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un ordinateur de la police contenant des informations sensibles est volé, les recrues, encore choquées de la mort d'un des leurs, découvrent qu'un informateur risque d'être compromis.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un prêtre menacé de mort par un trafiquant de drogue local, Andy and Nick réalisent que ses relations surprenantes risquent de les mener sur un terrain glissant.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une garde, un prisonnier braque une arme sur Chris. Alors que les affaires internes cherchent un coupable, les recrues cherchent le juste milieu entre dire la vérité et se soutenir.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un pédophile évadé lors d'un transfert enlève une jeune fille, Andy et Sam le traquent et se retrouvent dans un face-à-face mortel aboutissant à une véritable catharsis émotionnelle.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après six mois d'infiltration, Andy et Nick disparaissent l’un après l'autre. Pendant ce temps, Sam Swarek et les autres agents mènent une enquête qui tourne vite à la mission de sauvetage.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dès son retour, Andy travaille avec Swarek pour retrouver un ancien détenu, et réalise à quel point les choses ont changé depuis qu'elle s'est éloignée de son ancienne vie, il y a six mois.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy fait équipe avec la nouvelle petite amie de Swarek. Quand elles se retrouvent face à un homme hors de contrôle, leurs différences sont mises à l'épreuve et l'une d'elles doit faire feu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 The Kids Are Not Alright
programme.desc: Andy rêve d'un long week-end bien mérité, mais lorsqu'elle découvre un adolescent dans le coffre d'une voiture, elle cherche à le convaincre qu'aucun chagrin d'amour ne dure éternellement.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Marlo se retrouvent mises en quarantaine alors que la 15e Division se mobilise pour nettoyer les rues d'une drogue contaminée avant qu'une épidémie mortelle ne s'abatte sur la ville.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une jeune fille est portée disparue, la police découvre un lien avec une ancienne affaire délicate. Gail, elle, doit affronter ses pires peurs pour retrouver la jeune fille disparue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand des ossements humains retrouvés rouvrent une enquête vieille de 15 ans, Swarek se rapproche de son ancien instructeur et devra décider s'il veut continuer à suivre ses traces ou non.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 For Better, for Worse
programme.desc: La 15e Division souhaite passer une journée facile avant le mariage de Frank et Noelle, mais les choses tournent mal quand un bus de personnes âgées est attaqué et que la mariée disparaît.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le fils de Chris se fait enlever, la 15e Division met tout en œuvre pour le retrouver. Mais quand il est ramené à la maison, Chris fait face à une révélation difficile.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une descente dans une plantation de cannabis débouche sur la première affaire d'homicide de Traci, pendant que Swarek, Oliver, Chris et Dov partent passer une journée entre hommes.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand un pédophile est retrouvé battu à mort, Andy découvre que Marlo enquêtait sur lui hors du travail. Avec Swarek, ils vont tenter de la couvrir tout en retrouvant le véritable agresseur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand Andy et Chloe essuient les tirs d'un tireur embusqué, les agents de la 15e Division réalisent qu'ils doivent continuer à servir et à protéger la ville tout en étant pris pour cible.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 You Can See the Stars
programme.desc: Suite à une attaque ciblée contre la 15e Division, Andy, Swarek et leurs collègues doivent découvrir la vérité sur un ancien crime à temps pour sauver la vie à Oliver Shaw.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit éprouvante, Andy et Dov essaient de se ressourcer dans un restaurant ciblé par des braqueurs, pendant que la 15e Division tente de limiter les dommages collatéraux.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 All By Her Selfie
programme.desc: Oliver est promu sergent-chef et Andy forme une nouvelle recrue, mais quand ils interviennent ensemble sur un homicide, il semble que cette dernière va représenter un sacré défi pour Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 Heart Breakers, Money Makers
programme.desc: À l'approche de la Fite Nite, la 15e division doit faire de nombreuses saisies, mais Andy demande de l'aide à Nick pour éclaircir des aveux suspects concernant une maison de jeu illégale.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une fusillade mène à la découverte d'un chef de gang exécuté, la 15e Division cherche à éviter qu'une guerre des gangs n'éclate. Andy et Duncan doivent protéger le seul témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, l'intérêt de Chris pour un trafiquant de drogue éveille les soupçons de Dov. Duncan fait des accusations contre Andy, qui décide d'aider Sam dans une sombre affaire.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 Two Truths and a Lie
programme.desc: Andy et Sam décident d'interroger une liste de détenus d'un pénitencier, tous associés au principal suspect du meurtre de Brian Gowdy. Mais l'un d'eux est Jay Swarek, le père de Sam.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: Oliver prépare Andy à se défendre lors de l'audience de licenciement de Duncan, mais ce dernier avançant de nouvelles preuves, Oliver va compromettre son intégrité et son amitié avec Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le problème de dépendance de Chris atteint son paroxysme durant une enquête sur un cambriolage suspect qui révèlera un problème de famille dysfonctionnelle et qui les mettra en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors du déménagement d'un immeuble voué à être détruit, Andy et Chloe découvrent un homme torturé dans un appartement vide, et dévoilent une opération criminelle de grande envergure.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Duncan reprend du service et souhaite se réconcilier avec Andy, qui n'est pas prête. Mais quand une bombe explose dans le centre-ville, la 15e Division doit en arrêter l'auteur au plus vite.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division s'efforce de retrouver Ted Mcdonald, l'auteur de l'attentat à la voiture piégée. Une fois attrapé, ils réalisent qu'il a dispersé d'autres bombes dans la nature.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un mois après l'attentat à la bombe, Andy et Sam reprennent le travail. Mais quand Andy est agressée, la brigade des mœurs entre en conflit avec la 15e Division sur la manière de procéder.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Avec la grossesse de Marlo, Andy remet en doute son avenir avec Sam, mais son idée de la famille parfaite est remise en question quand elle rencontre une ado à la famille conservatrice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'un transfert, une émeute éclate dans une prison pour femmes. Andy et Juliet se retrouvent alors prises au piège avec une détenue qui veut à tout prix prouver son innocence.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le frère de Nick apparaît avec des informations sur une personne de leur passé, Nick décide de traquer l'homme en question, mais Juliet est sur ses talons.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division craint qu'un célèbre trafiquant d'armes n'ait kidnappé Traci, mais quand Andy réalise que c'est l'œuvre du violeur en série qui leur a échappé, tout le monde est mobilisé.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après une fusillade lors d'un match de baseball, la relation entre Gail et son frère est mise à l'épreuve. Pendant ce temps, Swarek planifie une escapade avec Andy, qui s'avère surprenante.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Sam sont choqués d'apprendre qu'Oliver est le principal suspect d'une affaire de corruption au sein de la 15e Division, et n'ont que jusqu'à la fin de la journée pour le disculper.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Oliver est toujours le principal suspect de l'attentat à la bombe, Andy, Dov, Gail et Nick entreprennent un plan risqué pour prouver que le commissaire Alonso Santana est corrompu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur frappe la ville, et le commissariat sert de station de rafraîchissement au public. Andy et Marlo recherchent une patiente disparue quand Marlo commence à accoucher.

programme.sub-title: S05 : E21 Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Andy vit mal l'arrivée de la fille de Sam et Marlo, et songe accepter une mission de quatre mois hors de la ville. Pendant ce temps, Jarvis annonce que la 15e Division va être restructurée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le jour de son mariage avec Sam, Andy découvre un homme mourant sur la route, sans possibilité d'appeler qui que ce soit. Parviendra-t-elle à le sauver et à se rendre à son mariage à temps ?

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le triomphe se transforme en humiliation lorsqu'une opération tourne mal et qu'Andy McNally, nouvelle recrue de la police, arrête l'un des siens et ruine une opération d'infiltration.

programme.desc: Alors que les autres se lancent à la recherche d'un détenu, Swarek parle à Andy de ses exploits. Alors qu'ils se lancent à la poursuite d'un informateur danger, et une étincelle jaillit.

Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control...

We are putting you in the know with all things in African and Nollywood cinema actors, actresses, directors, producers, classic cinema and soon to be blockbuster hits it's all here on AMC Movie Talk.

programme.desc: Catherine finally has enough of her abusive boyfriend, Hans, and, with the encouragement of her friend and business partner, Brienne, decides to move on. She believes she has met the perfect man online, but all is not as it seems and a setback sends her spiralling.

programme.title: Unfriendly Friends
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. In a world of crime, there are no brothers, merely men who have your back; Uche and Edu have each other’s backs. Following a recent scam, the duo have to lay low for a while, but when Yetunde, a girl from their past, turns up, she brings with her a measure of distraction. Both men are interested in her which causes them to fight, forgetting their relationship.

programme.title: The Couple
programme.desc: A happily married couple face some challenges when the husband loses his job and a jealous friend makes it her mission to destroy their lives.

programme.title: Dionee
programme.desc: Paul, a young mechanic, falls in love with an orange-seller, Dionee, and decides to send her to the city and pay for her education. After some time Paul proposes to her but Dionee rejects him, deciding she can do better than an illiterate man.

programme.desc: Detective Lazarus battles life and work as he solves various crime puzzles - from a missing will tearing a family apart, an important package setting him on a wild goose chase, a missing chief bridesmaid days before a wedding and an expensive heirloom. But each case has twists and turns and shows not all is what it seems.

programme.desc: Kayode loves women as much as he loves to lie about how much money he has. Now, he has become the most eligible bachelor in town and women want to keep him by all means. Unaware of Kayode’s true pocket status, the women fight over maintaining their position in Kayode’s life. Empowered by their charms, the women get Kayode to fall in love with all three of them at the same time. But is Kayode the man these women truly want to be with?

programme.title: Goodbye Yesterday

programme.title: Destined

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: When crime kingpin, Chief Fubara, steps back from his empire, his sons run it into chaos. Desperate to fix their mess, he brings his daughter into the fold, only to realize it’s too late. With the government closing in and enemies everywhere, he takes control once more, but lands himself in prison. Now, his children must break him out before he's transferred to Abuja.

programme.title: The Guest
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. When Seyi and Mabel lose their daughter in a car accident, Seyi blames Mabel for her death causing their marriage to suffer. They start to see a therapist and just when things seem to be getting better, Mabel quits on their marriage and moves away. Seyi starts a new relationship but a chance meeting with Mabel has him questioning his new life.

programme.title: Her Flatmate
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. When Rekia moves in with Kiki, they are on their way to becoming fast friends until Mabel, Rekia’s best friend, comes visiting and suddenly Kiki finds herself living with a devil in disguise.

programme.desc: Set in Lagos, Nigeria, the series tells the story of single and married women in the city. It explores how they perceive and view each other, which has led to unspoken conflicts between the two groups. One group believes itself superior to the other due to its status.

programme.desc: As tension rises within her marriage because of their childlessness, Tosin falls back into the arms of her ex-boyfriend.
